name: Otter
summary: Meeting transcription and summaries with action items, joined to your calendar and CRM.
description:
Otter does a job that people will pay to never do again: sit in the call, produce a searchable transcript with speaker labels, then a summary and the action items nobody wanted to type. Calendar integration and the ability to push notes into a CRM or project tool is what makes it stick in a sales and PM workflow rather than being a novelty.

Accuracy degrades fast on heavy accents, crosstalk and jargon, and a bot in the meeting is a consent question before it is a feature question — check your jurisdiction and your company policy. The interesting failure mode is a confident wrong summary of a decision, so keep the transcript linked wherever the notes go.
